events.evidence: The United States records a budget deficit of $1.42 trillion
One part of Movement for the Emancipation of the Niger Delta (MEND) ends a three-month ceasefire and resumes attacks on the oil industry
At least seven people are killed and at least ten are injured in an explosion at a mosque, police station and passenger bus in Peshawar, Pakistan

label.note: Deficit, MEND oil attacks and Pakistan bombing point to weaker risk appetite.
